$comment: Gemini responseSchema for LandingCheck. LESS-style screen of a drop-jump landing video. Not a validated LESS score.

video_ok.description: False if the athlete, both knees and both feet are not clearly visible through landing.

video_issue.description: If video_ok is false, a short, friendly instruction to re-film (e.g. 'Step back so your feet are in frame').

initial_contact_s.description: Timestamp in seconds when the feet first touch the ground after the drop.

present.description: True if this landing error is visible.

timestamp_s.description: Video time in seconds where the error is clearest.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. Use below 0.5 when the camera angle makes this hard to judge.

plain_language.description: One sentence an athlete understands, e.g. 'Your left knee caves inward as you land.'

summary.description: Two sentences max: the most important thing to fix. No medical claims.
